data.$comment: ZenSight types shared by several contracts: zs.thresholds.v1 and zs.desired.v1 must agree on ThresholdsConfig, so both list this file unchanged (Gap G12). Faithful to zensight-common/src/threshold.rs, comparison.rs, alert.rs (AlertSeverity) and desired.rs (AppliedConfig).

Ack.description: A write landed. v1 declared Ack without a schema ('ad-hoc JSON on the wire', zensight-common/src/schema.rs:225). In zk2 success is a value reply and failure a reply_err (O3), so nothing but an optional note remains.

AppliedConfig.description: What is actually in force for one reconcilable topic, and why (desired.v1's observed revision: desired_timestamp).

desired_timestamp.description: HLC timestamp of the applied desired sample (source = desired only).

effective_json.description: The document in force, JSON-encoded as a string. Its real type is the topic's.

topic.description: Repeats the key's {topic} (migration debt; tcgui gap 1).

ComparisonOp.description: Serialized in PascalCase (no serde rename); default GreaterThan.

timestamp.description: The rejected sample's HLC timestamp, when it carried one.

clear.description: Value hysteresis, on the quiet side of value.

labels.description: Label globs, all of which must match. v1 proxies matched `source` here; a device service no longer needs to.

metric.description: Glob over the resource path the service publishes (`if/*/in_errors.rate`). Under zk2 the paths change (the device leaves for the service name, rest families move under metrics/), so v1 rule sets need rewriting (migration debt).

name.description: Stable identity; becomes the alarm rule `threshold:<name>`.

ThresholdsConfig.description: The whole rule set one service evaluates, set wholesale (#928, #931). Every field is serde-defaulted.

data.$comment: The telemetry.v1 profile's self-describing point (r3.2 §4.9), written in the jsonschema kind because ZenSight's wire is serde's internally tagged TelemetryValue in CBOR (zensight-common/src/telemetry.rs:105-134, RFC 11 §4). r3.2 imagines a protobuf oneof: see Gaps G12/G13. Every contract that carries points lists THIS file unchanged, so the type identity (the file's sha256) is shared. Compared with v1's TelemetryPoint, `source` and `metric` are gone: they repeated the key's system/service and resource (r3.2 §3.11).

telemetry.v1.Histogram.description: Fixed buckets, cumulative since the producer's instance started (RFC 11 §4; zensight-common/src/histogram.rs). counts is per bucket, NOT cumulative, one longer than buckets, overflow last. buckets restate the resource's telemetry.buckets bit for bit; +Inf is implicit.

telemetry.v1.Point.description: One measurement. The series is named by the key: (system, service, interface, resource).

labels.description: Context that is not identity: an OID, an interface description, the original (unslugged) gNMI path.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the measurement was taken (not when it was published).

unit.description: UCUM-style unit (By, By/s, 1/s, %, s). Absent means unknown, never dimensionless. The resource's telemetry.unit annotation, when declared, is authoritative.

telemetry.v1.Value.description: Internally tagged: {"type": <kind>, "value": ...}. The tag is the resource's telemetry.kind spelled on the wire (boolean for bool). A resource without telemetry.kind (the rest-parameter families) is self-described by this tag alone.

value.description: serde's Vec<u8>: an array of byte values in both JSON and CBOR, not a CBOR byte string (Gap G9).

data.$comment: SNMP documents for zs.snmp.v1 (device services) and zs.snmp_poller.v1 (the poller service). Faithful to zensight-common/src/interfaces.rs, event.rs, outlet.rs, discovery.rs and targets.rs. Fields that repeat the key's service (device) are kept and flagged as migration debt.

credentials.description: A credential NAME into the host's file config, never a secret.

suggested.description: Suggested target name, which would become the device service's name.

EventRecord.description: A translated trap or inform (zensight-common/src/event.rs). `id` repeats the key's occurrence; `source` and `protocol` repeat the service (migration debt).

id.description: Lowercase ULID, equal to the key's {occurrence}.

IfStatus.description: serde externally tagged: a unit variant is a string, Other(i32) is {"other": n}.

OutletStatus.description: outlet.rs OutletStatus. `device` and `outlet` repeat the key (migration debt).

SnmpTarget.description: deny_unknown_fields. `name` is validated against [A-Za-z0-9._-] (targets.rs:179): it becomes the device service name snmp.<slug(name)>, and dots and capitals are legal (Gap G4).

credentials.description: A credential NAME; the wire never carries a community string or passphrase.
